rule: Each capture is a scripted probe, allowed only when explicitly authorized, logged, and stored as a fixture that states the version. No test and no CI job runs one. A capture that needs a paid call says so.

captures.question: What does approval mode ask do in a headless run with standard input closed?
captures.paid: one small call, under each permission mode

captures.question: Does the operating system enforce the permission mode (write outside and inside the workspace, network)?
captures.paid: one small call in read-only mode

captures.question: Which tool ids does the pinned version expose, and how are they listed without a model call?
Are several task arguments rejoined with one space on the proposer path; what size of one argument is accepted?
Which message forms have a limit with a reset time and a credit limit; what are the name and off value of the telemetry variable; does the trace plugin honour the trace parent?
captures.paid: no, unless a live limit message is wanted

captures.question: What does the composed profile of the pinned version load into a call (plugins, host hooks, skills, tool servers); does the harness keep a native memory across sessions; does a patch overlay or a setting switch each off?
captures.paid: no for the configuration dump; a check that a switch takes effect in a live call is a paid probe of its own
